newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Life sees profit lost if TOPIX under 1300.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Life sees profit lost if TOPIX under 1300.

text.p: Sumitomo Life Insurance Co said it would lose all of its unrealised profits on its stock holdings if the TOPIX index falls to about 1,300, a company official said on Monday.
In late Monday afternoon trade the index stood at 1,505.62, down 4.04 points or 0.27 percent.
The official also said the insurer plans 400 to 500 billion yen worth of fresh investment in foreign bonds in fiscal 1997/98, which started on April 1.
He added that the company plans 400 to 500 billion yen of new investment in domestic bonds in the same period.
